properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 2 at 11:21AM CDT until September 2 at 12:30PM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
At 1121 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain in Reports of flood have been
received from Tyler and Hardin Counties. Between 5 and 20 inches of
rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.25 to 0.5 inches in
1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lumberton, Silsbee, Woodville, Kountze, Sour Lake, Colmesneil,
Chester, Wildwood, Warren, Fred, Thicket, Saratoga, Town Bluff,
Village Mills, Honey Island, Caney Head, Spurger, Votaw and Batson.

Rainfall has generally tapered off to a much lighter rainfall than
earlier this morning. However numerous roads remain flooded and
closed across the warned area as water continues to drain.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Houston/Galveston has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

For the Menard Creek...including Rye...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Menard Creek near Rye.

* WHEN...From this afternoon to Saturday afternoon.

continue to rise to 27.0 feet early Friday morning. It will then

feet on 02/03/2012.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 2 at 12:22PM EDT until September 2 at 12:45PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
At 1222 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Fountainhead-Orchard Hills to near Carroll Valley
to 6 miles northeast of Hampstead to near Brogue, moving southeast at
40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damaging winds will cause some trees and large branches to
fall. This could injure those outdoors, as well as damage
homes and vehicles. Roadways may become blocked by downed
trees. Localized power outages are possible. Unsecured
light objects may become projectiles.

Locations impacted include...
Frederick, Hagerstown, Cockeysville, Westminster, Thurmont,
Emmitsburg, Municipal Stadium, Eldersburg, Reisterstown, Robinwood,
Taneytown, Hampstead, Walkersville, Fountainhead-Orchard Hills,
Manchester, Boonsboro, Smithsburg, Jarrettsville, Paramount-Long
Meadow, and Wilson-Conococheague.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 2 at 12:12PM EDT until September 2 at 12:45PM EDT by NWS State College PA
properties.description:
SVRCTP

The National Weather Service in State College PA has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Lancaster County in south central Pennsylvania...
Southeastern Lebanon County in south central Pennsylvania...
Southeastern York County in south central Pennsylvania...

* Until 1245 PM EDT.

* At 1212 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Mount Gretna Heights to Mountville to Shrewsbury to
Manchester, moving southeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Severe thunderstorms will be near...
East Petersburg, Manheim, and Lititz around 1220 PM EDT.
Delta, Strasburg, and Leacock around 1230 PM EDT.
Quarryville around 1240 PM EDT.

Other locations impacted by these severe thunderstorms include Buck,
East Prospect, Bowmansville, Peach Bottom, and Reinholds.

Radar has indicated rotation within these severe thunderstorms.
Although a tornado is not immediately likely, tornadoes can develop
quickly during severe thunderstorms.

This includes the following Interstates...
The Pennsylvania Turnpike from mile markers 267 to 295.
Interstate 83 from mile markers 0 to 10.
properties.instruction:
Stay inside a well built structure and keep away from windows.

Very heavy rainfall is occurring with these severe thunderstorms, and
may lead to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 2 at 11:49AM EDT until September 2 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Binghamton NY
properties.description:
At 1149 AM EDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in several
locations from heavy rain in Camillus, Solvay and surrounding areas.
Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen in less than 3 hours.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Syracuse, Baldwinsville, Cicero, Lysander, Pompey, Manlius, Owasco,
Otisco, Skaneateles and Liverpool.

Heavy rain was ending across the area but runoff into small streams
and creeks will continue for the next 1 to 2 hours leading to
additional flooding in the area.
properties.instruction: Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
